mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plt_device_credential WHERE tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND creator=#{q.actorId} AND project_id=#{q.projectId} AND external_connection_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT c.* FROM plt_device_credential c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND c.project_id=#{q.projectId} AND c.device_id=#{q.deviceId} AND c.credential_type=#{q.protocol} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.external_connection_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted=b'0' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plt_credential_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND g.credential_id=c.id AND g.grantee_type='USER' AND g.grantee_id=#{q.actorId} AND g.project_id=#{q.projectId} AND g.device_id=#{q.deviceId} AND g.protocol=#{q.protocol} AND (g.command_template_id='*' OR g.command_template_id=#{q.templateId}) AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.expires_at > #{q.now} AND g.deleted=b'0')=1 ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT * FROM plt_credential_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND credential_id=#{q.credentialId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM plt_device_credential WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM plt_device_credential WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND external_connection_id=#{id} AND deleted=b'0' FOR UPDATE
